limitations.text: No image candidate met both identity and reuse-provenance requirements. Dong Chinese page descriptions name historical stages and date ranges, but its image files were not accessible and no reuse license was found on the page. The Commons tracing is licensed CC0 but is not identified as 回. Academia Sinica’s official notice grants CC0 for query-interface glyph images and glyph attributes, but a specific 回 query record and image could not be retrieved. No glyph assets are proposed.

The available secondary pages label early forms as oracle and bronze script and provide approximate periods, but this research did not inspect a securely identified ancient 回 artifact image. Any future image candidate should distinguish a modern facsimile/redrawing from a photograph of an artifact.
